summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change moved payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2, which is unreachable, so payments failed silently (DEBUG only) while orders were marked processed. Worker got stuck in a wait state and the queue backed up (a restart was needed to resume processing).
recommended: Validate that payments-v2 is reachable before retrying the provider migration
Alert on DEBUG-level payment failures and on the worker wait state

events.text:
version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
The worker seems stuck waiting, so I should fix the config back to v1 first since v2 is unreachable after that migration change—reverting to v1 makes sense here.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.

Still broken:
- [business] payment_gap: 22 of 96 orders were processed but have no payment.
- [business] queue_backlog: Queue depth 60 and growing (was 51).
Worker appears stuck in wait; restart is now safe since payments work.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

args.summary: The provider migration to payments-v2 pointed at an unreachable endpoint, so payments failed silently. I reverted the config to payments-v1, restarted the worker and reprocessed all 22 unpaid orders. All invariants are now green.
